facts.statement: The entry reads a PNG from fuzz input through image rows and calls png_read_end with a separate end_info_ptr. Post-IDAT metadata is within the requested read-to-end operation.

The entry requires at least eight input bytes with a PNG signature and rejects images when width × height exceeds 100,000,000; its callback consumes the remaining input bytes and reports an overread through png_error.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines how PNG bytes are supplied to the reader.
Limits which image dimensions can reach png_read_end.

facts.statement: png_read_info stops at the first IDAT, leaving later chunks for subsequent reads. The harness then reads rows and calls png_read_end.

evidence.dependency_reason: Records IDAT state before later chunks.
Shows the harness's subsequent row and end-reading calls.

facts.statement: When compiled with PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED, the zTXt handler permits a chunk after IDAT, checks its keyword and compression type, and calls png_decompress_chunk for compressed text.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the cache gate and post-IDAT state handling, with no placement rejection in this handler.
Shows the accepted compressed zTXt format and call to the primary decompressor.

facts.statement: When compiled with PNG_READ_iTXt_SUPPORTED, a compressed iTXt chunk is another post-IDAT route to png_decompress_chunk, subject to its cache, format, and compression gates.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the cache gate and post-IDAT state handling.
Shows the compressed iTXt format gate and call to the primary decompressor.

facts.statement: An iCCP chunk after IDAT is rejected as out of place before profile inflation, so it cannot witness this frozen late-metadata obligation.

evidence.dependency_reason: The inflation path appears only after the placement check.

facts.statement: The supplied build recipe edits STDIO, WARNING, and WRITE options, then runs configure and builds the library and fuzzer. These lines do not resolve whether compressed text reading is enabled.

evidence.dependency_reason: The decompressor is conditional on compressed-text configuration.

facts.statement: The harness calls png_read_update_info before png_start_read_image. The former initializes rows and sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT; the latter then calls png_app_error for a duplicate call. Whether that error aborts this read is not established by the supplied png_app_error declaration.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the subsequent duplicate initialization call.
Shows the duplicate-call branch invoking png_app_error.

facts.statement: png_read_row also initializes rows if needed, and the configured interlace call returns seven passes for an interlaced image or one otherwise. Thus the harness has a row-reading route if the duplicate-call error returns.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the pass count used by the harness.
Shows that the harness uses that pass count to read rows before png_read_end.

facts.statement: The g0002 before and after decompression bodies both claim the stream, inflate compressed chunk data, and return its result; the displayed change in this region is comment text. This does not itself show that late compressed metadata became unreachable.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the before-side allocation, comment, memset, and continuation.

facts.statement: The complete old harness contains no assertion that post-IDAT compressed metadata was decompressed; its explicit checks cover signature and IHDR availability, and its error branches return zero.

missing_information: The complete before and after png_read_end bodies in pngread.c, to establish whether it dispatches post-IDAT zTXt or iTXt to their handlers.
The complete before and after png_app_error implementation and its effective default flags, to determine whether the duplicate initialization aborts before png_read_end.

The effective PNG_READ_COMPRESSED_TEXT_SUPPORTED, PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED, and PNG_READ_iTXt_SUPPORTED settings under the supplied recipe; provide scripts/pnglibconf.dfa and any delegated configuration needed to resolve them.
